_comment: Manifest of source documents to fetch from Google Drive for the KU-KIT Assistant's document repository — additional to what ingest.js already walks automatically from the local ku-kit/assets/docs/ tree (see _discovery below). driveFileId entries need to be fetched to source-files/<localFile> first (Claude Code's Drive connector can do this directly; a plain Node script can't without separate Drive OAuth setup).
_discovery: Checked this session (2026-08-31): the 4 Drive folders the user pointed at as 'knowledge to add' turned out to already be sitting locally under ku-kit/assets/docs/ — a richer staging area than what's actually committed to git (see ku-kit/.gitignore: only specific *.pdf files in a few subfolders are un-ignored; the PPTX originals and several whole subfolders — parts/, manuals/, maintenance/, authenticity/, pre-delivery/, product-knowledge/ — are real, present on disk, just never committed).

Verified by exact byte-size match against the Drive listing: assets/docs/maintenance/*.pptx (Engine/PowerTiller Maintenance EN+TH) and assets/docs/parts/Parts-Book-ZT140.pdf and Power-Tiller-Recommend-Parts.xlsx are byte-identical to their Drive counterparts. assets/docs/parts/Diesel-Engine-Recommend-Parts.xlsx differs in size from the Drive copy (79924 vs 115372 bytes) — a different edit/version; used the local one since it's what's already integrated into this machine's pipeline.

Net result: nothing needed re-downloading from the 4 Drive folders for this ingestion pass. ingest.js's ingestAssetsDocsAll() walks every assets/docs/ subfolder generically (PDF + PPTX) instead of a fixed folder list, which is what actually picks all of this up.
_deliberatelyExcluded: RecommendParts_Master_ZT_NC.xlsx (Drive file 1VCopb8ZXXScGBtjJyVY0P6fY-VYWBzEe, in the Parts Drive folder) is NOT ingested anywhere in this pipeline. Per Handoff.md's own provenance notes for this exact file, it has internal-only columns (Basis / _life_reference / _first_lot_value / _needs_verification / _gateA_dropped) that were deliberately kept out of the site when parts-catalog.json was built from it. Bulk-ingesting the raw workbook into a dealer-facing RAG corpus would risk surfacing that internal data through the Assistant. If a future need calls for pulling more from this file, extract only the already-vetted customer-safe fields (same ones parts-catalog.json already uses), never the whole sheet.

.xlsx files in general are excluded from ingestAssetsDocsAll()'s automatic walk for the same reason — spreadsheets in this project have a track record of carrying internal-only columns alongside customer-safe ones, and a text-dump extractor (extractXlsx() in extract.js) can't tell the difference. Review a spreadsheet's actual columns by hand before adding it to the `documents` list above as an explicit, deliberate opt-in.
